svg.title: FleetPermit: least privilege for agents, across every cluster
svg.desc: Animated overview. FleetPermit on the Open Cluster Management hub holds time-bound permits on cluster-east and cluster-west. sre-agent calls tools there and is allowed. security-agent is not in any policy and is denied. cluster-edge is outside the placement, so calls to it are denied. A 10-minute lease countdown drains; at expiry the permits dissolve and the same call from sre-agent is denied by the gateway, without the hub. A new lease delivers fresh permits and the loop repeats.
svg.text: Define who can call which tool, on which
Built on Kubernetes, Open Cluster Management,

text.tspan: sre-agent holds the lease, so its calls on east and west pass
security-agent is not in the policy
cluster-edge is outside the placement, so it has no permit
the lease runs out and the permits dissolve
the same call after expiry, enforced by the gateway itself
